pre_update_notes: Every new toggleable feature ships off/disabled by default — review and opt in from Settings at your own pace after updating. If OE_UPDATE_AUTO_SECURITY or a manual apply previously used the deleted NotifyAdminsOfAutoUpdate/AutoUpdateResultMail classes directly (rather than through the normal apply flow), note those were renamed to NotifyAdminsOfUpdateResult/UpdateResultMail in this release.
post_update_notes: The largest release since 1.0.0: a 22-phase “bulletproof, zero critical-bug” testing pass across the entire application found and fixed real bugs across security (7 vulnerabilities, a CSRF gap, coupon abuse), finance (VAT was overcharged on every coupon-discounted order), compliance (cookie-consent scripts fired before consent, account deletion left real PII behind), and reliability (every support-reply email has silently shown neither the customer's message nor the reply, a cache-forever-on-failure bug that could have pinned routing/hreflang to a fallback forever, the mobile API had no maintenance-mode gate). Also adds Paysera as a second payment gateway, an admin-triggered full production restore, payment-dispute admin alerts, and a build-freshness check that prompts a refresh when the running deploy goes stale. See CHANGELOG.md for the full list.
